recipe.visualDefinition: A wide-angle landscape photograph featuring a dusty desert road leading toward a distant mountain under a vast, overcast sky. In the lower right foreground, a weathered red vintage pickup truck is parked, carrying a plush red velvet sofa in its bed where a solitary figure sits. The typography is centered in the upper third of the frame, utilizing contrasting styles for the artist and title.
coreVisualRelationships: The red truck and sofa act as a vibrant focal point against the muted earth tones of the desert.
The vast sky occupies the upper two-thirds of the frame, emphasizing isolation.
The diagonal line of the road leads the eye from the bottom left toward the central mountain peak.
coreInvariants: Juxtaposition of domestic furniture (sofa) in a wild environment
Muted blue and tan color palette with a single red accent

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject (truck and figure) is positioned in the lower right quadrant, scaled to occupy about one-sixth of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red pickup truck provides the heavy visual anchor for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the red truck, follows the road back to the mountain, then rises to the centered typography in the sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space in the sky and the left-hand desert scrub creates a sense of openness.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted beige and dusty blue (landscape and sky)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation across the landscape with a sudden burst of medium-saturation red in the foreground.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of a delicate, high-waisted serif and a heavy, geometric sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Upper line: Thin strokes, flared terminals, high crossbars.
Lower line: Thick, blocky, horizontal emphasis with rounded outer corners.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' in the top line has a distinctively wide, open curve.
The 'E' in the bottom line features a middle bar that is shorter than the top and bottom bars.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a delicate, tall serif and a heavy, wide sans-serif.

preserve: The high-waisted nature of the top font
The blocky, extended nature of the bottom font
avoid: Standard Helvetica or Times New Roman

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the high-waisted, Art Nouveau serif feel of the top line.
Matches the blocky, horizontal weight of the bottom line.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle landscape photo of a dusty desert road leading to a mountain under a cloudy, desaturated sky. A vintage red pickup truck with a red velvet sofa in the back is parked in the lower right foreground. Film grain and 1970s color grading.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered text in the upper third of the sky. The top line should be a thin, high-waisted Art Nouveau serif in dark blue. The bottom line should be a heavy, extended geometric block font in rust red.

verificationChecks: Is the truck positioned in the lower right?
Is the sky desaturated and grainy?
Does the typography use two distinct, contrasting styles?

adjustableVariables: Tracking of the top text line
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the person
Any visible brand logos on the truck
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red of the truck and sofa is the only high-chroma element.
Check that the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Verify the grainy, matte texture of the overall image.
Confirm the road creates a clear diagonal lead-in.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a desaturated, wide-angle landscape with a single, brightly colored vintage prop in the foreground, topped with high-contrast vintage display typography.
